ssm:AddTagsToResource.note: Denied by design and re-justified: the pointer is NOT a secret (it holds the deployed image reference, ecs-task.ts:163, written at runtime by setImagePointer, ecs-operations.ts:188) but the deploy role must never write SSM parameters (bootstrap test 'never read or write secret values'). No sanctioned replacement exists today: ECS task-definition secrets and container environment cannot carry the image, the deploy role may not read secret values, and tofu has no variables. Consequence found by this diff: for built artifacts both the aws_ssm_parameter resource and setImagePointer fail at IAM. Needs an owner decision (a dedicated brokered pointer-writer role like the secret writer, or native task-definition ownership of the image with ECS ignore_changes), not a wider deploy grant.
